title: Region-aware priority throttles and variant safety for dedicated→hosted overflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: when dedicated capacity is saturated in a region or tier, we currently spill requests to hosted variants with simple priority checks. That has caused intermittent QoS regressions for high-priority tenants during multi-region congestion and led to incorrect variant selection in a few incidents. This ticket proposes a region-aware, tenant-prioritized throttle + compatibility safety layer that: 1) computes a per-region headroom score for dedicated pools, 2) enforces tier-aware throttles that respect tenant reservation and transient surge allowance, and 3) validates candidate hosted model variants against a compatibility matrix and quality budget before spillover. Goals: reduce regressions when spilling to hosted, keep high-priority tenants' tail latency predictable, prevent low-compatibility models from being used as last-resort fallbacks, and instrument clear telemetry for post-incident analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Per-region headroom score implemented and emitted to metrics; headroom = available_tokens / expected_token_drain over 60s
Tier-aware throttle logic that consults tenant reservation + surge allowance and prevents spillover when it would breach tenant QoS budget
Variant compatibility checker that blocks hosted fallback variants with a compatibility_score < 0.7 unless an explicit emergency override is set
Circuit-breaker hysteresis (open/closed window) to avoid flip-flopping during noisy capacity signals
Integration tests simulating multi-region capacity exhaustion with assertions on routing decisions
Rollout gated behind feature flag and traffic shadowing; no impact to default traffic without opt-in
Dashboard panels for headroom, spillover rate by tenant, fallback variant usage, and per-tenant tail-latency spike attribution
design_notes: Headroom scoring: combine GPU queue depth, current inflight tokens, and historical per-tenant token rate to estimate safe spill amount. Use exponential smoothing alpha=0.15 for stability.

Throttle policy: evaluate in order - a) reserved capacity consumption, b) tenant surge budget (configurable per-contract), c) global safety floor. If any check fails, deny immediate spill and either queue request (short wait) or return a 429 with suggested retry-after and fallback hint.

Compatibility matrix: model metadata includes tags for semantic parity, output distribution distance (KL estimator), and latency overhead. Map to compatibility_score in [0,1]. Keep matrix in Consul + GCS backup and refresh hourly.
Demotion TTL: when a variant is demoted due to quality regression, mark it with a 10-minute demotion TTL before auto-reconsideration. Demotion reasons and metrics must be auditable.

Hysteresis: open circuit for 30s after threshold breach, then enter probed half-open where up to 5% of requests can try hosted spillovers for validation. If healthy, close circuit and resume normal service.
implementation_plan: Add headroom calculator to capacity-proxy service and expose Prometheus metrics: region_headroom, region_inflight_tokens, region_queue_depth
Extend routing policy engine to add two new checks: tenant_surge_budget and compatibility_score_threshold
Implement compatibility scorer service that loads model metadata and computes score; add unit tests for edge cases
Wire circuit-breaker state to Config Service with per-region keys and admin API for manual override
Add feature flag (ff-smart-routing-safeguards) and a shadow routing mode to mirror decisions to debug logs without affecting live traffic
Create e2e test harness that replays production traces to validate decision boundaries and latency impact
telemetry_and_metrics: alert: spike in spillover_blocked_by_compatibility > 50/min for 5m -> P1 on-call notification
dashboard: per-tenant latency before/after spillover, and model-level quality regression heatmap
testing_plan: Unit tests for headroom math and compatibility_score boundary conditions
Simulated multi-region saturation test: create dedicated pool overload and assert routing decisions for 1000 tenants with varied priorities
Chaos test: flip circuit-breaker states under load and assert no request amplification or unintended retries
Integration tests with Console: ensure feature flag toggles are respected and rollout APIs report correct state
Canary: enable feature flag in region eu-west-1 for 10% of traffic for 48 hours and run synthetic transactions measuring tail-latency and fallback quality
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (shadow): deploy to staging and enable shadow mode for 100% of staging traffic. Validate metrics for 3 days.
Phase 2 (canary): enable feature flag in production eu-west-1 for 10% traffic for 48 hours. Monitor dashboards and alerts.
Phase 3 (regional rollout): expand to other regions in 25% increments with manual gate checks between waves.
Phase 4 (global): flip default on for all regions, leave compatibility_score threshold adjustable via runtime config for 2 weeks before locking down
blockers: model metadata ingestion pipeline must include distribution stats (ENG-13890)
tenant surge budget API needs stable schema update (ENG-33211)
require product sign-off on default compatibility threshold
